description: This file defines an asynchronous utility function 'withTempDir' that creates a temporary directory with specified options, runs a callback function within that directory, and then cleans up by removing the directory afterward.

methods.name: export async function withTempDir<T>( withTempDir
methods.description: An async function that creates a temporary directory, executes a callback within it, and cleans up the directory afterwards.

ctags.name: base
ctags.pattern: /^  const base = await fs.mkdtemp(path.join(options.parentDir ?? os.tmpdir(), options.prefix));$/

ctags.name: dir
ctags.pattern: /^  const dir = options.subdir ? path.join(base, options.subdir) : base;$/

ctags.name: path
ctags.pattern: /^  const dir = options.subdir ? path.join(base, options.subdir) : base;$/
